title: Hey all, happy to share my combat demo from my upcoming RPG Rise of the Breakers: The Immortal Fear
author: Braunb8888
selftext:
This is a game I’ve had in mind for a long time with a 40 page GDD written 10+ years ago that just kind of sat on my computer. With the influx of ai tools I can finally do something about it.

The gameplay is based on some of my favorite combat systems in JRPGs through the years, with inspiration from Xenogears, Valkyrie Profile and Clair Obscur being the most obvious. 

The font is a bit in your face which will be fixed, but let me know what you like, don’t like etc. I’ve toyed with standard turn based or ATB, settled on ATB for now. Hope you like it and  planning on releasing a demo within a month or so.

comments.author: sevenoutdb
comments.body: The action looks great, coming along nicely!

comments.author: blvckhippy13
comments.body: Looks pretty cool, I’d be interested in demoing or play testing it

replies.author: Braunb8888
replies.body: Absolutely, will have something demo ish ready in about a week. The opening 30 minutes or so. How long should demos be you think?

replies.author: blvckhippy13
replies.body: 30 mins is fine but I’d say 1 hour is the sweet spot for me, depending on what kind of game it is.  It just needs long enough to allow the player to find the fun and want to play more.

replies.author: Braunb8888
replies.body: Story focused for sure, some cutscenes, good amount of dialogue, good amount of combat. I’m aiming to have a starting hour that hooks you like the bombing mission in ff7.

comments.author: soulo222
comments.body:
You need a lower camera angle I’d say, for the sprites which will make them look much better and less “flat”

And also the UI looks a bit “ai slop” 

Other than that it looks cool, I like the timing aspects and the art style

replies.author: Braunb8888
replies.body: Yeah I’m gonna change the ui for sure this is just to show the animations and systems at play really. There will also be elemental and status effects and enemy’s have special attacks as well.
